capabilities: Render latex code blocks as embedded PDFs
Render latexsvg code blocks as SVG via pdftocairo
Fetch LaTeX packages on demand from CTAN
Cache generated PDFs and downloaded packages
Invert SVG colors to match light or dark themes
disambiguation: Not inline math typesetting like Obsidian's Math feature; it compiles whole LaTeX documents from code blocks into PDF/SVG images.
extras: README warns that XeTeX currently does not work with CTAN-fetched packages, mobile support is listed only as a TODO, and some SVGs may not display in reading mode or PDF export due to a suspected Obsidian bug.
intentEvidence: Thanks to fenjalien who created  which this plugin is based on
problem: Compiling full LaTeX documents in Obsidian normally requires a local TeX installation, and core math rendering only handles math snippets, not whole documents.

relations.evidence: Thanks to fenjalien who created  which this plugin is based on
This is achieved using the SwiftLaTeX wasm LaTeX compiler built into the plugin

summary: LaTeX compiler plugin that renders latex code blocks into embedded PDFs or SVGs using a built-in SwiftLaTeX WebAssembly compiler, with no local TeX install.
